positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
- Co-founded SiteDetour, an online SaaS for managing 301 and 302 redirects
 - Built product MVP (ReactJS, MySQL, ElasticSearch, GraphQL)
 - Architected highly available hosting environment using AWS

positions.title: Director of Software Engineering
positions.description:
- Lead software engineer developing an award winning CMS for the Hospitality industry
 - Managed Programming and DevOps departments
 - Product Owner for multiple web-based Hospitality applications

positions.title: Senior Manager of Engineering
positions.description:
Programmer of proprietary website CMS utilized at international digital marketing agency:
 - Oversaw team of 10 full-stack engineers
 - Responsible for the programming of MVC based, PHP driven application to provide highly available, load-balanced hotel websites
 - Responsible for complex production AWS workload of over 500 EC2 instances
 - Ensured high quality through integrating TDD practices, along with regular static analysis
 - Programmed Facebook photo-sharing application utilizing Graph API
 - Collaborator with Project Managers and Product Managers for strategic product development initiatives

positions.title: Teacher's Assistant and Tutor
positions.description:
- Worked in the department of Computer Science assisting students with beginner and intermediate C++ programming and
data structures courses
 - Reinforced topics such as polymorphism, inheritance, object-oriented programming, data structures, probability, logic, and functions
 - Assisted students with principles of discrete mathematics

positions.title: Client Associate
positions.description:
- Developed data-mining software for analyzing SEC filings of equity transactions
 - Streamlined sales initiative by providing parameterized filtering of resultant data
 - Lead internship recruiting efforts by conducting interviews and hiring seasonal interns
